request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change only the colours of his clothes and skin: the red bandana and red tunic become near-black dark brown leather with one lighter brown stitched hide patch and a rusted orange-brown iron belt buckle; his skin a yellower, saturated yellow-green olive. No yellow on the clothes. Keep the face, ears, dagger, belt, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
